title_en: At Hipoteka, Super Apartment 1+1 With Parking Post For Sale!!
description_en: Near the mortgage, on Albanopoli street, super apartment 1+1 with perfect floor plan for sale. The apartment has a gross area of ​​73.9 m2, net 64 m2 and is located on the 6th floor of an 8-story building. The apartment is organized in the corridor, which is divided into the living room together with the kitchen corner with access to the balcony, a bedroom and a bathroom with a window with a small balcony.
